messages:
aaron-cust: Hey team — we just got our monthly invoice and sales tax was applied even though we submitted a WA resale certificate months ago. Invoice ID `INV-2026-5589`. Can you please check?

jess-support: Sorry about that, Aaron. Can you confirm the PO number and the billing address on the invoice? I can start a lookup.

aaron-cust: PO 78932. Billing address shows: 120 Market St, Seattle, WA 98101. Resale certificate on file under tax-exempt ID `WA-RE-102344`.

jess-support: Thanks — forwarding to billing. @sam-billing can you pull invoice `INV-2026-5589` and tax calculation logs?

sam-billing: Got it. Pulling now. Quick note: the invoice metadata has billing_address_state=WA but tax_region resolved to CA during external tax lookup. :thinking_face:﻿

maria-finance: That mismatch would explain it. Did the tax provider map using card BIN or corporate HQ? Any chance the address fallback used a parent entity?

sam-billing: Looking at the audit trail: tax-service returned jurisdiction "CA" with reason "address_normalization_failed, fallback_to_profile_zip". The profile zip on file is `94105` (San Francisco) from an older parent company record.

aaron-cust: That SF zip is our parent company address — billing should use the branch address in Seattle. We submitted a resale cert for the Seattle entity specifically.

jess-support: OK that's helpful. @dev-tax-engine can you check why normalization preferred profile zip over invoice billing address? We shouldn't fallback if explicit billing address present.

dev-tax-engine: Investigating. Initial hypothesis: recent change to address validation tightened matching and the normalization step returns null on extended fields (suite numbers) and then a fallback picks the customer profile zipcode. Reproduced locally: invoice with full street+suite -> normalization returns empty; fallback picks profile.zip.

dev-tax-engine: Repro steps: 1) create invoice JSON with billing_address {street:"120 Market St, Suite 400", city:"Seattle", state:"WA", zip:"98101"} 2) run normalize() -> returns null due to comma+suite parsing mismatch 3) tax_lookup() uses profile.zip (94105) 4) tax_service returns CA nexus -> tax charged. Attached test log snippet:

```
normalize(): input="120 Market St, Suite 400" -> output=null
profile.zip=94105
tax_lookup(jurisdiction)=CA
applied_tax=9.25% (CA)
```

sam-billing: Thanks — can we short-term rule: if invoice.billing_address.state present, prefer that over profile.zip? Need to patch quickly.

dev-tax-engine: Agreed. I'll push a hotfix that treats explicit billing_address.state as authoritative for jurisdiction resolution and skips profile zip fallback. Will add a unit test for suite-comma parsing. ETA 2 hours.

jess-support: Great. Maria, if we confirm fix, can finance issue a credit note for the tax portion and reissue corrected invoice?

maria-finance: Yes. Once dev confirms hotfix in staging and we validate invoice recompute -> we will create a credit for the taxed amount and reissue INV-2026-5590 (corrected). Also I'll check tax-resale flags on the account so future invoices are zeroed.

invoices-bot: Payment schedule for INV-2026-5589 paused pending credit.

aaron-cust: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Any ETA for the credit/reissued invoice?

jess-support: Targeting credit + new invoice within 24 hours after dev patch. We'll keep you posted. Sorry again for the hassle. :pray:

dev-tax-engine: Hotfix pushed to staging @ 1833003600. Ran reconciliation script on test invoice -> jurisdiction resolved to WA, tax = 0 (resale cert honored). Pushing to prod after 30m smoke tests.

sam-billing: Confirmed staging recompute: `INV-2026-5589` tax line now 0.0. Maria, you can proceed with credit generation once prod patch is live.

maria-finance: Will wait for prod signal — please ping when at `1833004200` or later.

jess-support: Noted. @aaron-cust we'll DM you once credit done and attach corrected invoice. Thanks for flagging.

aaron-cust: Thanks everyone!

dev-tax-engine: PROD patch deployed at 1833004205. Running reconciliation for affected invoices with fallback issue.

maria-finance: Credit note issued: `CN-2026-2101` for the tax amount $432.21 and reissued invoice `INV-2026-5590` with zero sales tax. Email sent to billing contact.

jess-support: Closing loop: root cause = address normalization failure + profile zip fallback. Fix deployed to prefer explicit billing state over profile ZIP. Action items: (1) Add more robust parsing for suites/commas (dev), (2) add alert when tax lookup uses profile.zip fallback (dev/ops), (3) finance to audit last 30 days for similar mismatches (finance).

aaron-cust: Confirmed received corrected invoice and credit. All good from our side. Thanks again!"
